title: Restatement § 71 — exchange requirement
summary: The consideration inquiry requires a performance or return promise bargained for.
notes: The assigned chapter explains reciprocal exchange and uses Hamer to distinguish a requested act from a gratuitous promise. This is a study account of the section as discussed in C&M. The complete assigned section, comments, and illustrations in SEL have not been imported.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 49–61. Open assigned page 49.
